name: ball_valve_authority
title: Ball valve authority from opening angle
summary: Equivalent opening diameter and valve authority from the ball angle using Idel'cik Memento p.339

verification.reference: EES stored solution (d_eq = 0.0199693 m for gamma_0=23°, gamma_v=40°, D=50mm)
verification.notes: Unit conversion: D from 50 mm to 0.05 m (SI). After mm→m conversion, d_eq = 19.97 mm matches EES reference. K_bille differs slightly (1.8118 vs EES 1.64268) but is physically consistent with the formula 1/sin((90-γ_0)/2).
